CCPIA CERTIFIED COMMERCIAL BUILDING INSPECTORS

Welcome to Arizona Commercial Property Inspections – the leaders in the commercial building inspection industry. We have years of experience, and we are fully certified through CCPIA (Certified Commercial Property Inspection Association) and NACBI (National Association of Certified Building Inspectors).

We provide a high level of customer service, thorough commercial building assessments, and a detailed inspection report delivered to you within 24 hours of your on-site inspection.

Whether you are buying, selling, or currently own a commercial building, we are here to provide you with accurate information about the true condition of your property.
